newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt's Abu Qir announces rights issue.
newsitem.headline: Egypt's Abu Qir announces rights issue.

text.p: Egypt's privately owned Abu Qir Fertilisers and Chemical Industries said on Sunday it would increase its capital through a rights issue.
The firm said in a published announcement it would issue 8,232,760 new shares to increase its capital by about 21.8 percent from 151 million pounds ($44.5 million).
Shareholders can buy a minumum of five shares and a maximum of 21.8 percent of their holdings at 45.00 pounds per share, plus an issuance fee of 0.25 pounds, it added.
The closed offer will be open for one month from April 29. State-owned Bank of Alexandria is the agent for the offer.
